Frequently Asked Questions

What exactly am I buying?

A downloadable AI prompt pack and mini playbook. You get guided fill-in-the-blank prompts, follow-up commands, and planning steps for exploring side-hustle ideas.

Is this software?

No. It is not an app or subscription. You copy a prompt, add your details, and paste it into the AI assistant you already use.

Which AI tools can I use?

The prompts are written for general-purpose assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and comparable tools. King Hustle Plan is not affiliated with those providers.

Do I need a paid AI account?

No paid AI account is required to use the pack itself. Free AI accounts may have limits, slower responses, or fewer features depending on the provider.

Will this guarantee that I make money?

No. The pack helps you think through realistic options, but results depend on your skills, local demand, effort, pricing, judgment, and follow-through.

How do I receive the product?

After the owner connects checkout, delivery should happen through the commerce platform as a digital download or email delivery.

Can I share or resell the prompts?

No. The purchase is for personal use. Do not resell, publish, upload, repackage, or share the prompt pack publicly without written permission.

Are refunds available for digital downloads?

The final refund policy must be approved by the owner before publication. The draft policy page explains that digital-product refund rules are still under review.

Is King Hustle Plan affiliated with ChatGPT, OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, or another AI provider?

No. King Hustle Plan is independent and is not endorsed by, sponsored by, partnered with, or officially connected to any AI provider.

Is the Starter Kit included?

No. The Starter Kit is a separate $27 product for people who already have a service idea and want help with pricing, materials, labor, fuel, and customer communication.
